limitations: Only three identically distributed independent observations; no higher-draw or non-Euclidean optimal constants established. Earlier majorization work and an inaccessible full comparison manuscript leave residual originality risk.

scientific_integrity.computational_status: Exact-rational finite-grid and enumeration checks complement but do not prove the global theorem.
scientific_integrity.derivation: Exact degree-three expectation and two explicit nonnegative algebraic certificates.
scientific_integrity.priority_caveat: Qualitative Schur-concavity is previously established; stronger component-wise comparisons are known, and unindexed quantitative equivalents may exist.

summary: The global three-draw rearrangement-diversity deficit has exact sharp two-sided Euclidean quadratic coefficients on each finite probability simplex, with distinct complete equality classes.
title: Sharp two-sided quadratic stability for three-draw rearrangement diversity
